text:
noelle: Quick QA pairing request  want to run a smoke pass on all code snippets and migration examples for naming consistency (model_id, model_variant_id, modelVariantId) and make sure the examples in docs match the snippet-runner tests. Can @tara or @zach pair?

tara: I can pair for the snippet-runner checks this afternoon. What's the scope? Full repo grep or just migrate/ and examples/?

noelle: Start with examples/, migrate/, and quickstart. If we find systemic mismatches we'll run a repo-wide grep. Main issues so far: curl bodies using form-encoded model=, JS examples using model_id instead of modelVariantId, and a couple of Python snippets using modelVariantId (should be model_id).

zach: I pushed a tiny test harness that loads snippets and runs them against preview backend endpoints. It validates JSON fields and checks for deprecated keys. I'll open a branch: snippets/qa-runner.

qa-bot: snippet-check: detected 9 curl snippets with form-encoded 'model='; flagged lines in examples/curl.md and migrate/curl-examples.md

noelle: Thanks. Tara, can you run the harness locally and add a short report to PR #522? Prefer one PR per fix type (curl -> #523, JS casing -> #524, python -> #525).

tara: On it. Small note on naming: prefer prose use "model variant" (two words). In code samples, show language idiomatic names and add a 1-line mapping comment. I'll add that to the style guide PR too.

zach: Ran the harness against preview and attached results: mismatch summary + files. I also added an auto-fix flag that rewrites curl form-encoded to JSON body with model_id. Want me to enable auto-fix for the curl hits?

noelle: Yes, enable for curl hits only. For JS/Python, open small PRs so humans review casing and param intent. We don't want automated renames for ambiguous usages.

doc-bot: lint: examples/js/chat.md contains "model_id" in JS snippet at line 34; suggestion: change to "modelVariantId" for JS.

zach: Created branch snippets/auto-fix-curl with fixes for the 9 curl snippets. CI preview: https://preview.docs.redwood/branches/snippets/auto-fix-curl (checks passed)

noelle: Great. Tara, once you run the harness and review the JS hits, can you update PR #524 and tag me? I'll review the mapping comment in the style guide.

tara: Will do. Quick sample I added to style guide appendix:

```python
# Python (SDK v2)
resp = client.generate(model_id="gpt-4-mini", input="Hi")
```

```javascript
// JavaScript (SDK v2)
const resp = await client.generate({ modelVariantId: 'gpt-4-mini', input: 'Hi' })
// Note: modelVariantId in JS maps to model_id in backend
```

zach: Also found one migration snippet still linking to /migrate/old-embeds. I patched it in the auto-fix branch to /migrate/embeddings-batch and left a comment with the redirect.

noelle: Awesome. Plan: merge curl auto-fix today after a quick review, open the three small PRs for language fixes, and canary deploy docs tomorrow morning. Tara/Zach, please drop the harness report in PR #522 and add the list of touched files.

qa-bot: run-complete: snippet-runner finished (9 fixes auto-applied, 7 warnings, 12 review-needed)

zach: Pushed PR #523 (curl JSON fixes + alias example), PR #524 (JS casing fixes - draft), PR #525 (Python snippet fixes - draft). Linking them in the snippet-runner report.

noelle: Perfect. I'll review #523 now. Tara, thanks for pairing. If others see additional mismatches, please add them to the report so we can batch follow-ups. :sparkles:
